protocol.target: full filtered three-state latent belief, not a marginal or product with an added nuisance factor
protocol.coordinate_interpretation: Trivial: both coordinates action-unnecessary. Reward-State: rho resolves the reward-state partition; delta is the action-irrelevant within-nonreward contrast. Full-State: both can matter for action selection; delta is not a task nuisance there.
protocol.classes: Own-history uses each checkpoint's own greedy classes; fixed-history uses final-policy classes for every encoder.
protocol.head_blind: 62-dimensional null space of two logit-difference head rows; each encoder's own head; common logit shift retained
protocol.pooled_r2: 1 - sum(class SSE)/sum(class test-mean-centered SST); class-specific affine refits
protocol.matched_init: Fixed-history trajectory generalizes matched initialization to every selected encoder, with exact final-policy streams/targets/classes, empty episode caches, warmup included and probes refit.
protocol.controls: Not recomputed for trajectories; controls are in the separate within-class final/init analysis.
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 pointwise episode resamples; 10000 paired peak-minus-final resamples, probes fixed; seed 20261106.
protocol.archive_rule: Historical discrepancy threshold max(0.01, 5 * CPU episode-bootstrap SE), now annotations only by user authorization. No archived-parity hard stops. Primary matched comparisons use verified checkpoints and identical CPU histories.
protocol.intermediate_selection: Prespecified index-based early geometric / late even grid, including saved midpoint; all selected steps listed in each arm.
protocol.undefined: constant/empty class R2 null; predictions excluded when class has fewer than two fit rows; counts explicit
protocol.collector_confirmation: PR219 changes only training sampling/likelihoods through exploration_epsilon; greedy argmax and key splitting unchanged; shared probe/models/env/training files unchanged. Local collector is equivalent for greedy probes ignoring temperature and epsilon.
protocol.selection: Prespecified index-based hybrid: geometric early and evenly spaced late checkpoints, plus init/midpoint/final; no decoding-dependent selection. All durable checkpoints listed; selected points only analyzed.
protocol.trajectory_scope: No additional controls; full h, head-blind, logits, delta, rho and independent global belief probe refit at each point on own and fixed histories. Fixed histories/targets/classes always final-policy streams; own greedy reward reported separately.
protocol.uncertainty: Pointwise whole-test-episode percentile bootstrap; class means recomputed, probes fixed. Peak-minus-final uses paired episodes and fixed probes; selected-peak CI is exploratory, not selection-adjusted. One training seed only.
protocol.reward: Realized pre-transition reward per scored greedy rollout step, not expected reward from belief; 64-step warmup excluded; fixed-history rewards belong to final policy, not replayed encoder.

provenance.import_method: git archive from recorded PR219 SHA; only selected transformer arms and recipe/environment sources retained; no merge/rebase

fixed_peak_minus_final.selection_caveat: Peak selected by observed full-h fixed-history R2 among sampled checkpoints; paired CI conditions on this chosen peak and fixed probes, not corrected for peak selection or unsampled checkpoints.
